name: texture-card
blurb: Layered nested borders create depth and tactile surface texture.
description: Compound card component with cascading border rings that increase perceived depth without shadows. CSS-only, theme-aware, composed of TextureCard, Header, Title, Description, Content, Footer, and Separator subcomponents.
use_when: Cards need subtle depth and texture without heavy drop shadows; designing minimal or technical interfaces.
avoid_when: Designs requiring motion or hover-triggered reveals; the component is static CSS.
a11y: Semantic structure with sections and text layers; no interactive elements or motion to manage.
